com.mqttsnet.basic:thinglinks-databridge-starter 1.0.8.1 发布, 通用数据桥接组件 ── 为业务侧提供统一的 Sink (Kafka/Redis/RocketMQ/MySQL/HTTP/WebHook/MQTT)
        与 Source (Kafka/MQTT/HTTP) 协议适配能力。

        ⚠️ 严格遵循 OCP：本 starter 不感知任何业务字段（租户/设备/产品/桥接规则），
        所有协议适配只接受通用 ConnectorPayload (byte[]+Map+key) 和 ConnectorConfig (JSON 配置)。
        业务侧自行做 envelope 序列化 / pool key 拼接 / 重试编排。

    compromised-password checker on top of the V00.71 SPI from
    jSentinel-core. The checker uses the k-anonymity range API: only
    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation
    relies on JDK HttpClient only — no additional runtime dependencies.
    Strictly opt-in; applications that do not depend on this module
    perform no online lookups.

com.usebila.api:bila-java 0.2.0 发布, Bila Payment Gateway API - A payment processing API for Africa.

## Overview

This API provides payment gateway functionality for:

- **Account Management**: Manage payment accounts/wallets
- **Bank Operations**: Access bank reference data
- **Account Resolution**: Verify bank and mobile money accounts
- **Transfer Recipients**: Manage saved transfer recipients
- **Transfers (Payouts)**: Send money to bank accounts and mobile money
- **Collections (Receive Payments)**: Collect payments via mobile money
- **Transaction History**: View all transactions

## Mobile Money Providers

- Airtel Money
- MTN Mobile Money (MoMo)
- Zamtel Kwacha

## Countries Supported

- Zambia (zm)
- Nigeria (ng)

## Authentication

Use your merchant API key in the `x-api-key` header. You can generate API keys
from your merchant dashboard.

## Base URL

```
https://api.usebila.com/api/v1
```

For sandbox/testing:

```
https://sandbox.usebila.com/api/v1
```
